title: orchid-mcp: MCP server and Python package for ORCHID
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and Python package for querying ORCHID (Open Repository for CALPHAD Hypotheses, Intelligence, and Discovery): literature values with their thermodynamic states, evidence classes and provenance, calculated phase diagrams, TDB files, phase registry, DFT references and the bibliography, for researchers and AI agents.
notes: This work was supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation under awards OAC-2608825 and 2534344.
